question: If the ratio of the cost price to the selling price is 5 ∶ 7, then what is the profit percentage?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Ratio → CP : SP

 5 : 7

% Profit = (7 - 5)/5 × 100 = **40%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Formula used:**

Profit% = (SPover CP - 1) × 100 or,

Profit% = (SP - CP)/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Substituting the values, we get

⇒ P% = (7over 5 - 1) × 100

⇒ P% = 2over 5 × 100 = 40%

**∴ The profit percentage is 40%.**
